additional_info.subject: Incorrect ICCID Data in BootNotification
additional_info.body:
Hi Team,
We received the following feedback from our customer regarding Siemens devices:
The ICCID value sent in the BootNotification message appears to be incorrect. The devices use Turkcell SIM cards, which cannot start with “900” as currently indicated.
Specifically, the device with chargerID:
SGYTwW is still sending boot notifications.
Here is an example of the reported boot notification data:
{
"iccid": "90011908060375016F",
"firmwareVersion": "v6.1.3-0-gfb2eb75 (PRODUCTION)",
"chargePointModel": "SICHARGE D",
"chargePointVendor": "Siemens AG"
}
Could you please investigate the issue and advise on corrective actions?
Thank you in advance for your support.
With best regards,
Yunus Emre Temel
Siemens Sanayi ve Ticaret Anonim Sirketi
RC-TR SI E CS
Yakacik Caddesi No 111
34870 Istanbul, Türkiye
Mobile: +90 5300504719
mailto:emre.temel@siemens.com
www.siemens.com
